reuse.why: All six month-wide actions take the new behaviour from the existing getFillableCategories selection, extended with one parameter.

duplication.why: The hidden rule now lives only in getFillableCategories' SQL; the redundant hidden/group_hidden check in copyPreviousMonth is removed rather than duplicated.

placement.why: The selection rule stays in the existing category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts; actions only forward the flag.

scope.why: Only the helper, the six action signatures and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Clear single parameter; the only cost is repeating the same optional-flag boilerplate across six signatures.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the per-site hidden check in copyPreviousMonth was removed in favour of the helper.
